pwa_guide_android_description: You can add this app to your home screen from the browser menu.
pwa_guide_android_step1: Tap the menu button (⋮) at the top right (or bottom right) of the screen.
pwa_guide_android_step2: Tap “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
pwa_guide_android_step3: On the confirmation screen, tap “Install” or “Add”.
pwa_guide_chromium_description: You can install this app from the browser menu.
pwa_guide_chromium_step1: Click the install icon at the right end of the address bar.
pwa_guide_chromium_step2: If you can't find it, look in the browser menu for items such as “Install app” or “Install this site as an app”.
pwa_guide_install_description: Add this app to your home screen to use it comfortably as an app.
pwa_guide_ios_description: On iOS / iPadOS 16.4 or later, you can add this app to the home screen from browsers other than Safari. If it doesn't work, open this site in Safari.
pwa_guide_ios_step1: Tap the share button near the address bar or in the menu.
pwa_guide_ios_step2: Tap “Add to Home Screen” (if you don't see it, look under “More”).
pwa_guide_macos_description: On Safari for macOS Sonoma or later, you can add this app to the Dock.
pwa_guide_macos_step1: Click “File” in the menu bar (you can also use the share button in the toolbar).
pwa_guide_safari_description: You can add this app to your home screen from Safari.
pwa_guide_safari_step1: Tap the share button (it may be in the “…” menu next to the address bar).
pwa_guide_safari_step2: Tap “Add to Home Screen” (if you don't see it, look under “More”).
pwa_guide_safari_step3: If “Open as Web App” is available, turn it on, then tap “Add”.
pwa_guide_samsung_description: You can add this app to your home screen from Samsung Internet.
pwa_guide_samsung_step1: Tap the menu button (≡) at the bottom of the screen.
pwa_guide_unsupported_description: This browser does not support installing the app. Please use Chrome, Microsoft Edge, or Safari.
